node.title: The layer above the pipeline: the certifier provably succeeds for EVERY admissible p
node.statement: WORKING INTERPRETATION ADOPTED (project decision 2026-07-03): Reading B — the determination artifact is a proved-correct procedure yielding the certified delta*_C for any admissible C. Under B the layer restructures: correctness = certificate self-verification (easy); TOTALITY = free with an EXACT (complete) solver, since each row's question is finite and branch-and-bound terminates with a verdict — the UNKNOWN outcome is eliminated by solver completeness, not by a uniform distance theorem. Residuals: (a) practical runtime on queried rows (empirical, demonstrated on exhibited rows; partials creditable); (b) judged acceptability of procedure-as-determination (favorable signals; settled by peer review). INSURANCE RETAINED: the classical uniform-GV theorem remains mapped as the fallback should review demand Reading A; uniform multiplier existence (QA.19) stays valuable as an efficiency theorem.
node.attack_surface: (i) first: uniform multiplier existence is a counting argument, delegable; then the uniform-L window census quantifies exactly which rows remain exposed; (ii) is where genuinely new mathematics would live if the rules demand a classical uniform theorem
node.falsifier: a prime for which no k <= poly multiplier system achieves the distance (the toy bake-off's k-vs-GV data previews this)
node.notes: Reading B adopted as working interpretation by project decision; the boss dissolves into solver completeness + engineering + judgment.
